summary: StudentActiveCohort manages active cohort assignments for students, including course enrollments, cohort details, and system behaviors related to assignment and removal from cohorts.
purpose: To track, assign, and remove cohort-course associations for students and provide detailed information used in academic scheduling and validation.

workflows.name: StudentSearchActiveCohorts
steps: Run DB query and read results
For each result, populate StudentActiveCohort fields
Add valid StudentActiveCohort entries to list
Return list of active cohorts for student

workflows.name: StudentRemoveFromCohort
steps: Add session, student, and cohort parameters
Run DB query and read results
For each result, populate StudentActiveCohort fields
Add valid StudentActiveCohort entries to list if conditions met

business_rules: Skip any StudentActiveCohort entry where AssignedCourses and UnassignedCourses are both zero
validations: Only add StudentActiveCohort entries to result list if AssignedCourses != 0 OR UnassignedCourses != 0
calculations: UnassignedCourses is calculated as EnrolledCourses minus AssignedCourses
conditions: When reading cohort results, skip all-zero entries
When searching for temp-assigned courses, move through recordsets until 'Course' is found
system_behavior: DB procedure selection and parameter setting
exceptions: If DB reader returns null, skip processing
Skip entries with all-zero course assignments
content_gaps: No explicit description of error handling for other DB failures
No detail on UI or external triggers for workflows
No information on how course assignment/removal interacts with other system modules
